elements.text:
Each day you will receive a short survey at the time you chose. It asks about craving, mood, substance use, and how many minutes you used the device.

Once a week you will also receive a brief weekly survey that reviews the past week and asks about recovery meetings and support.

Each survey only takes a minute or two. If you miss one, just continue with the next one — and if you have an issue with the device, the study team will follow up with you.
